items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Frankie Duesen went out. Frankie Duesen? Charlie Love didn't go with him? I don't know. Must have been Buddy P.T. Buddy and Frankie Duesen. Oh, Buddy and Frankie. When I heard that, yeah, I heard they went out there.

ctx.x: They didn't really have the style. No, they didn't have it at all. No, they didn't have the style. We wrapped it up when we went there.

Yeah. Yes, indeed. But Buddy P.T. and I believe Charlie Love was out there before us, wasn't he? Did he ever tell you? I believe, no, not Charlie. Frankie Duesen went out. Frankie Duesen? Charlie Love didn't go with him? I don't know. Must have been Buddy P.T. Buddy and Frankie Duesen. Oh, Buddy and Frankie. When I heard that, yeah, I heard they went out there.

And Joe Oliver didn't go out until about 1921. He took his band out. Yeah, I was back here. You were back there. He stayed out there a good while, didn't he? Quite a while in San Francisco and then stopped in Los Angeles a while.
